description: 2024 Hawkesbury-Nepean River Flood Study is a dataset listed in NSW Government open data portal (data.nsw.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by NSW Reconstruction Authority. The Hawkesbury-Nepean River Flood Study (May 2024) provides high-resolution spatial and temporal data identifying areas in the Hawkesbury-Nepean Valley affected by flooding, including backwater inundation of tributaries, and assesses the potential impacts of climate change on flood behaviour. Coverage: New South Wales. The portal files it under the publisher NSW Reconstruction Authority. Its tags are Flood Study, Hawkesbury-Nepean River. It offers 9 resource(s) in pdf, zip. The portal shows 2025-10-08 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-nsw.
